jobs.description:
As Key Account Manager, you grow the company's business with industrial customers across Europe. You look after existing customers, and you bring in new ones. You spend a lot of time visiting customers, and you work closely with the logistics and purchasing team at headquarters.
    
• Manage and develop existing key accounts in Europe  
• Winning new customers in the company's current markets and applications  
• Spot and develop new projects with customers, from the first technical conversation through to supply  
• Negotiate prices and terms, keeping the agreed margins in mind  
• Prepare the yearly sales budget, track volumes and margin every month  
• Keep a close eye on the market, competitors and customer needs, and share what you learn with the team 
  
• At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales in the chemical industry; experience in coatings, adhesives, sealants or polymer applications is a strong plus  
• You have built your own network of customers in the industry and can add value from your first day  
• You like developing new business and you are fully hands-on; you get your energy from working with customers  
• You think like an entrepreneur and understand financial figures, because you manage your own budget and margins  
• You are interested in the technical side of the products and can talk about them confidently with buyers and R&D teams  
• You are fluent in English, any other European language is an asset  
• You are happy to travel regularly to customers across Europe

Van Heyghen Staal is a modern steel service center located in Evergem, in the Ghent canal zone near the Port of Ghent. Founded in 1981, the company processes around 250,000 tons of steel plates per year on its cut-to-length and slitting lines, and supplies hot-rolled sheets, plates and slit coils to clients across Europe in a wide range of sectors. Its strong position in the European market is built on quality, innovation, service and just-in-time delivery. To support its automated production lines and upcoming projects, Van Heyghen Staal is looking for a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics.

Jobomschrijving

Job descriptionAs a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics, you will start with an extensive learning program in which you will get to know our activities and automated lines in detail. You will build expertise in technology, processes and concepts. After this onboarding period, you can grow within Maintenance, Operations or Projects, depending on your interests and talents.

• Managing spare parts and helping plan preventive and corrective maintenance.
• Analyzing breakdowns and developing sustainable solutions.
• Actively contributing to investment and innovation projects.
• Coaching and supporting the technical team so that production runs continuously and optimally.
• Taking part in a rotation to coordinate Saturday maintenance approximately every 6 weeks.
• Contributing to digitalization and automation projects.
• Supporting energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives.
• Monitoring and improving technical safety procedures.
• Involvement in a production line renewal project.

Profile

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Electromechanics.
• Preferably at least 3 years of experience, but motivated starters are also welcome (junior profile with some experience).
• Broad technical interest: mechanics, pneumatics, electronics, hydraulics and electricity.
• Hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented.
• Knowledge of automation, drive technology and technical drawing is a plus.
• Good command of English is essential; additional languages

Company

• Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.

• Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

In 1932, Belgian baker Jan Boone created a caramelised biscuit made only from natural ingredients. He named it Lotus, after the flower that symbolises purity. In the 1950s, Boone began wrapping his Speculoos individually and introduced them to cafés and restaurants as “the biscuit to enjoy with your coffee”. The idea was an instant hit, because coffee and Lotus Speculoos are made for each other: each one brings out the best in the other’s flavour, and together they form the perfect duo. Over the years, the popularity of Lotus Speculoos grew enormously, far beyond Belgium’s borders. From a caffè latte to an espresso to go, coffee lovers all over the world ask for a Lotus. Internationally, the biscuit is known as Lotus Biscoff, a contraction of “biscuit with coffee”. Today, Speculoos is much more than a biscuit to go with your coffee. Creative chefs also use it as an ingredient in delicious desserts such as tiramisu and speculoos mousse.

Jobomschrijving

What you will do

Your profile

• Driven, reliable and proactive, able to work both independently and in a team
• Good English; Dutch is not required
• Valid Belgian work permit
